title: DNA Extraction Protocol from Sterivex Filters
author: Meghan M. Shea
materials: Immediately transfer tubes to room temperature
For each sample and extraction blank follow the remaining Qiagen DNeasy Tissue and Blood Kit steps:

Assemble materials and reagents needed: 1000 µL pipette tips (that fit in the inlet of the Sterivex) 200 µL pipette tips Proteinase K (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) ATL Buffer (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit)

Assemble other reagents & materials needed: Sterile 3 mL syringes (one per sample) AL Buffer (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) Buffer AW1 (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) Buffer AW2 (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit)

Assemble materials and reagents needed: 1000 µL pipette tips (that fit in the inlet of the Sterivex) 200 µL pipette tips Proteinase K (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) ATL Buffer (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit)

Assemble other reagents & materials needed: Sterile 3 mL syringes (one per sample) AL Buffer (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) Buffer AW1 (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) Buffer AW2 (from Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit)

steps.title: Decontaminate bench and equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the bench area with bleach, ethanol, and RNase Away; wipe down 1000 µL, 200 µL, 100 µL, and 10 µL pipettes with RNase Away and UV for 15 min on each side; soak all tube racks in 10 % bleach, rinse three times with DI water, let dry and UV for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare incubator and ethanol
steps.instruction: Turn on the incubator and set it to 56 °C; place a 50 mL tube of molecular‑grade ethanol in a freezer or on ice to chill for later use.

steps.title: Retrieve and cap Sterivex filters
steps.instruction: Remove Sterivex filters from the –15 °C freezer, take each filter out of its Whirl‑Pak bag, remove the cap from the inlet end, and keep the inlet cap ready for reuse.

steps.title: Add ATL buffer to filters
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette 720 µL ATL buffer onto each filter through the inlet, avoiding backsplash, then secure the filter with the same luer cap.

steps.title: Incubate filters with ATL
steps.instruction: Place all filters on the roller shaker inside the incubator, rotate at ~6 rpm, and incubate at 56 °C for ~24 h (minimum 12 h, keeping the incubation time consistent for all filters).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette 80 µL Proteinase K onto each filter through the inlet, expelling slowly to avoid backsplash.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit and LoBind tubes
steps.instruction: UV‑sterilize Qubit and LoBind tubes for 15 min in pre‑sterilized tube racks and label them: Qubit tubes = (#samples + extraction blank) + 2 standards; 1.5/2 mL LoBind tubes = (#samples + extraction blank) × 3; 5 mL LoBind tubes = #samples + extraction blank. Open and label spin columns (#samples + extraction blank) and collection tubes (#samples + extraction blank) × 2.

steps.title: Heat AE buffer aliquot
steps.instruction: Calculate AE buffer volume = (#samples + extraction blank) × 100 µL × 1.1; heat this aliquot on a heating block at 70 °C.

steps.title: Collect lysate from filters
steps.instruction: Remove filters from the incubator, remove caps, and using a sterile 3 mL syringe attached to the inlet, aspirate all liquid, record the volume, and transfer it into a 5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin columns
steps.instruction: Pipette the lysate onto a DNeasy Mini spin column in 650 µL portions, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 × g (8000 rpm), discard flow‑through, dab the rim dry on a Kimwipe, and repeat until all lysate has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to the spin column in a new collection tube, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 × g (8000 rpm), then discard the flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to the spin column in a new collection tube, centrifuge 3 min at 20 000 × g (14 000 rpm) to dry the membrane, discard the flow‑through and dab the rim dry on a clean Kimwipe.

steps.title: Final spin before elution
steps.instruction: Place the spin column back in a collection tube, centrifuge 1 min at 20 000 × g (14 000 rpm), then transfer the spin column to a new 1.5/2 mL LoBind tube (cap left open) and place the tube in a 70 °C heat block.

steps.title: First DNA elution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Buffer AE (process four samples at a time) directly onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, then centrifuge 1 min at 6000 × g (8000 rpm).

steps.title: Second DNA elution
steps.instruction: Apply the eluate back onto the spin column while it remains in the heat block, incubate 10 min at room temperature, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 × g (8000 rpm), and discard the spin column. Each LoBind tube now contains 100 µL DNA extract.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit assay
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 µL of each DNA sample into labeled Qubit assay tubes. Prepare Qubit working solution: reagent volume = ((#samples + extraction blank + 2) × 1) × 1.1 µL; buffer volume = ((#samples + extraction blank + 2) × 199) × 1.1 µL. Vortex to mix.

steps.title: Run Qubit fluorescence assay
steps.instruction: Add 199 µL working solution to each Qubit sample tube; add 190 µL working solution to each of the two standard tubes; add 10 µL respective standard to each standard tube; vortex gently without creating bubbles; incubate 2 min at room temperature; read fluorescence on the Qubit fluorometer and record concentrations.

steps.title: Archive DNA extracts
steps.instruction: Transfer ~50 µL of each DNA extract to two pre‑marked LoBind tubes: one labeled “archive” for storage at –80 °C (first 50 µL) and one labeled “working” for storage at –15 °C (remaining volume).

steps.title: Process extraction blank and final wash
steps.instruction: Create an extraction blank by adding 1000 µL nuclease‑free water to a 5 mL LoBind tube. For each sample and the blank, add AL buffer and 0 °C ethanol in a 1:1:1 ratio, vortex vigorously for 10 s, then filter the mixture through a spin column following the same wash and elution steps (steps 10‑15).

steps.title: Final decontamination
steps.instruction: Clean the bench area, vortex, centrifuge area, and centrifuge with bleach, ethanol, and RNase Away.
